metadata.case_name: MA KWAN TUNG v. WONG WING KWONG

injuries.description: fracture distal radius and ulna of right wrist
source: X-rays of right forearm showed fracture of distal radius and ulna.
She was diagnosed with fracture distal radius and ulna of right wrist; and contusion of right shoulder, left knee and forehead.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

source: She was diagnosed with fracture distal radius and ulna of right wrist; and contusion of right shoulder, left knee and forehead.
Examination revealed pain and deformity over right wrist, pain and bruising over right shoulder and forehead, and pain over left knee.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of shoulder or upper arm

source: She was diagnosed with fracture distal radius and ulna of right wrist; and contusion of right shoulder, left knee and forehead.
Examination revealed pain and deformity over right wrist, pain and bruising over right shoulder and forehead, and pain over left knee.

injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

injuries.description: fracture of the left leg due to a fall in a swimming pool on 27 July 2010 (prior injury, fully recovered by time of Accident)
source: Prior to the date of the Accident, she had a fracture of the left leg due to a fall in a swimming pool on 27 July 2010 of which she already fully recovered by the time of the Accident.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower leg, including ankle, unspecified

injuries.description: contusion of the face, left clavicle and left leg
source: She was diagnosed to suffer contusion of the face, left clavicle and left leg.

Immediately after the Accident, she was admitted to the A&E of TKOH, and suffered from pain and abrasion over the left clavicle area close to the left shoulder. Bruising was found over the right eyebrow area and left leg.

injuries.description: contusion of both shoulders, left knee, right leg and right face
injuries.body_part: both shoulders; left knee; right leg; right face
source: Examination revealed bruising over right leg, swelling over left knee, and pain over right angle of jaw, left posterior pelvis and both shoulders. She was diagnosed with contusion of both shoulders, left knee, right leg and right face.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of shoulder or upper arm

manifestations.description: Pain and deformity over right wrist
Pain and bruising over right shoulder
Bruising over forehead / swollen face ("black eye" about 3 inches, subsided after 2 to 3 weeks)
Easier tiredness of the hand, and needed more frequent breaks during prolonged writing and drawing
Swollen area around right eye; teased by classmates; felt embarrassed and distressed
Bruising over right leg, swelling over left knee, pain over right angle of jaw, left posterior pelvis and both shoulders

treatments_received: Admitted to the Accident & Emergency Department of Tseung Kwan O Hospital (TKOH)
Admitted to the orthopaedics ward of TKOH (Chan Tsz Wing)
Put on a long arm cast (Chan Tsz Wing)
Long arm cast trimmed to a short arm cast on 13 October 2010 (Chan Tsz Wing)
Cast removed on 3 November 2010 (Chan Tsz Wing)
Referred for regular follow-up treatments at the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of Prince of Wales Hospital (PWH) on 29 September 2010 (Chan Tsz Wing)
Discharged from TKOH on same day (Ma Kwan Tung and Chan Mei Ling)
treatments_future: No further medical treatment required (Chan Tsz Wing)
No follow-up treatment required (Chan Mei Ling)

losses.description: Pain, fracture and resultant temporary functional limitation of the right wrist including easier tiredness of the hand and need for more frequent breaks during prolonged writing and drawing; general pain and bruising from the Accident (PSLA awarded HK$150,000).
Contusions and facial swelling (including a "black eye"), bruising and embarrassment/distress at school following the injury (PSLA awarded HK$50,000).
Contusions of both shoulders, left knee, right leg and right face with associated pain (PSLA awarded HK$80,000).

comparable_cases.injury_description: 26 year old plaintiff sprained his left wrist; scaphoid fracture in his left wrist; reduction and screw fixation surgery performed; 6 months later removal of the implant performed; hospitalised for 5 days.
